title.narrative: China Biodiversity Facility

description.narrative: The CBF overarching goal is to improve biodiversity and environment protection in China through nature based solutions and good governance. The CBF facility is planned on an 8 years duration time and is organized in 3 distinct components (plus one separately financed by AFD and Chinese authorities). The EU contribution is earmarked.
